description: 한국전자통신연구원_기술 이전 목록 정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전자통신연구원. 연구원 연구결과물중 기술이전 대상 목록으로 기술명, 기술개요, 기술이전 목적 및 필요성, 기술 특징 및 특장점, 활용방안 및 기대성과를 제공한다. 컬럼명: 번호, 기술명, 첨부, 작성자, 날짜. The portal shows 2021-06-01 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
